THE COMMUNITY GUIDE

Keep the shot.
Clean the sound.

SoundShredder helps you clean unwanted audio from a generation you want to keep. Drop in a video or audio file, choose what stays, audition the result, and download the mix or isolated tracks.

Unwanted generation audio

Use with exported Seedance or Genjutsu clips when the picture works but extra voices, music or effects distract.

A soundtrack you want to replace

Remove background music from an MP4 or MP3, then build your own score around the remaining audio.

Effects you want to keep

Isolate movement, impacts and ambience for your edit, or remove the effects layer when it is unwanted.

Persistent bubble sounds

Use Bubble FX for targeted cleanup, with aggressive multi-pass for stubborn Water bubbles.

ONE FILE IN. MORE CONTROL OUT.

Local processing. Windows and Mac launchers. CPU or NVIDIA GPU. Audio stays on your computer.

01 / GET STARTED

Download. Launch. Drop.

Get the latest Windows or Mac ZIP from GitHub Releases. Extract the entire folder before launching. These are Python packages with setup launchers; Python is installed separately.

WINDOWS

Install Python 3.12 with Add Python to PATH. Run Start SoundShredder.bat. Use the CPU or NVIDIA setup launcher if you want to choose the runtime explicitly.

MAC

On macOS 12 or newer, install Python 3.11 using the universal2 installer. Run Start SoundShredder.command. If Finder refuses it, run bash followed by the dragged launcher path in Terminal. Read START HERE - MAC.txt.

  1. Export your clip first

    Save your Higgsfield generation locally. Drag one video/MP4 or audio/MP3 onto the drop zone, or choose browse files. No separate audio extraction is needed.

  2. Choose the processing device

    Auto uses a compatible NVIDIA GPU when available, otherwise CPU. Mac uses CPU. The fallback checkbox retries on CPU if GPU memory fills up.

  3. Choose a preset and process

    Select the cleanup you need, then click Separate audio or Clean up bubbles. Leave the launcher window open.

FIRST RUN

The app installs dependencies and downloads model weights: about 426 MB for layer separation and 1.2 GB for Bubble FX. Later processing can work offline. CPU runs can take longer. Mac hardware validation is still outstanding; Apple Metal acceleration is not implemented.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 02
02 / CHOOSE WHAT STAYS

Start with the right preset.

Presets set the dialogue, music and effects levels for you. You can still change the sliders: 0% removes a layer, 100% keeps it, and values between them reduce it.

PRESETWHAT IT DOESWHEN TO USE IT
Remove musicKeeps dialogue + effectsReplace a generated score while retaining scene audio.
Dialogue onlyKeeps dialogueExtract voices for editing or a dialogue-focused mix.
Effects onlyKeeps sound effectsReuse impacts, movement and ambience.
Remove effectsKeeps dialogue + musicReduce unwanted SFX across the effects layer.
Remove dialogueKeeps music + effectsReduce unwanted voices or narration.
Bubble FXTargets bubble-like soundsReduce a bubble sound while working from the original mix.

  1. Listen, then refine

    After separation, adjust the layer levels and click Update mix. Normal layer changes reuse the separated tracks, so another model run is not needed.

  2. Check the category before removing it

    Effects includes ambience, footsteps and impacts. Dialogue removal is not an individual-speaker selector. A layer preset cannot pick out every arbitrary noise by itself.

EXAMPLE: UNWANTED VOICES IN A GENJUTSU CLIP

Try Remove dialogue to retain the music and effects. If you want only the scene effects, try Effects only. Listen for any wanted breaths or vocal details that the separation also affects.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 03
03 / TARGET A BUBBLE SOUND

Less bubble. More scene.

Choose Bubble FX when a generation has a distracting bubble, pop, gurgle or cartoon-like sound. This mode estimates that sound in the original mix instead of removing the entire effects layer.

  1. Match the sound

    Choose Water bubbles, Bubbling & popping, Liquid gurgle or Cartoon boing. Start with the closest description.

  2. Limit the range when possible

    If the problem happens only from 0:07 to 0:11, check Limit cleanup to a time range, enter 7 and 11, then clean up. Leave it unchecked for the whole clip.

  3. Audition the default, then adjust

    Start around 85% reduction. Compare the original and cleaned mix, then listen to Removed sounds. Lower the reduction or narrow the range if wanted effects are being caught.

PROTECT THE REST OF THE CLIP

Decoded audio outside the selected interval stays unchanged in the exported float WAV. Inside it, similar pops, liquid effects or overlapping sounds may also be reduced. Bubble FX is experimental.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 04
04 / STUBBORN WATER BUBBLES

Give cleanup another pass.

Aggressive multi-pass is especially useful when a first cleanup leaves persistent bubble remnants. Every pass analyzes the audio left by the previous pass, giving the model another opportunity to find the remaining Water bubbles.

PASS 1

Clean the original

PASS 2

Recheck what remains

PASS 3 / 4

Optional stronger cleanup

  1. Use 2 passes as your starting point

    Choose Water bubbles, enable Aggressive multi-pass, and select 2 passes. Keep the range tight when you know where the unwanted sound occurs.

  2. Escalate only if the clip needs it

    Try 3 passes for stronger cleanup or 4 passes for the maximum option. The chosen reduction level applies on each pass. Extra passes take longer on both GPU and CPU.

  3. Listen to the combined removal

    Removed sounds contains everything taken out across the passes. If it includes wanted impacts, ambience or vocal details, reduce the strength or pass count.

  4. Rerun from the saved original

    Click Clean up again to use the saved original in a new session. Changing pass count, sound type, or multi-pass strength/range requires fresh processing. The earlier result remains available.

MORE PASSES MEAN STRONGER CLEANUP, NOT A GUARANTEE

The aim is to reduce stubborn bubbles while keeping the scene useful. More aggressive settings can also remove wanted effects. Compare the original, cleaned and removed tracks before choosing your final version.

Single-pass shortcut: with one pass, strength and range changes can use Update mix. Aggressive multi-pass is available for Water bubbles only.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 05
05 / LISTEN AND DOWNLOAD

Every layer, its own track.

The Listen to each layer module presents four separate strips: Dialogue, Music, Sound effects and Removed sounds. Each has a waveform, player, seek control, preview volume/mute and an individual WAV download.

COMPARE THE SAME MOMENT

Playing a track pauses the others. Leave Keep playback position when switching tracks enabled for A/B comparison. Turn it off for independent positions. Preview volume does not change the exported mix.

BUBBLE SESSION? PREPARE THE LAYERS

Click Prepare isolated tracks if dialogue/music/effects are missing. They are separated from the original audio before bubble cleanup. Removed sounds comes from the cleanup; preparing layers preserves that result.

Normal layer separation prepares the listening tracks automatically. Removed sounds contains the portions excluded by your latest exported mix. If every layer is kept at 100%, that track can be silent.

A SIMPLE LISTENING ROUTINE

Play the original to hear the problem. Play the cleaned mix to judge the result. Then audition Removed sounds: it should mostly contain the audio you meant to take away. Download any track you want to keep working with.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 06
06 / TAKE IT INTO YOUR EDIT

Download exactly what you need.

Use the cleaned mix as your replacement audio, or download separate tracks for more control in your editor. The files retain the source duration so you can align them to the original clip.

DOWNLOADWHAT YOU GET
Download cleaned WAVThe kept audio, ready to import into your video editor.
Download on a trackThat isolated layer, or the audio removed by the latest export.
Normal separation ZIPDialogue, music, effects, cleaned mix, removed audio and report.
Bubble cleanup ZIPCleaned audio, combined removed sound and report. Download any separately prepared layers individually.

BACK INTO YOUR EDIT

Import the cleaned WAV into Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or your editor. Align it to the original clip start and mute the original clip audio. Check sync and transitions. Video inputs produce audio outputs; SoundShredder does not export a replacement MP4.

  1. Build your final soundtrack

    Layer in your own score, foley or replacement dialogue. Separate downloads let you adjust each element on its own track.

  2. Keep the processing report

    The report records how the session was processed. Save it with your WAVs when comparing different strengths, ranges or pass counts.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 07
07 / THE LEFT PANEL

Start fresh. Keep your work.

1. Start a new session

Click Audio separator at the top of the left panel. It clears the current workspace so you can drop in another file. It does not delete your completed saved sessions.

2. Reopen an earlier result

Click a filename under Recent sessions to restore its saved settings, previews and downloads. Use the refresh icon beside the heading to refresh the list.

3. Understand the x

The x beside a filename deletes that local session after confirmation. It is not a harmless close-tab button. The uploaded copy and generated files are removed; your original source file outside the app remains untouched.

4. Leave a session without deleting it

Use Audio separator to start fresh, or close the browser tab. Completed sessions stay on disk. Save any mix adjustments with Update mix first; unsaved slider changes are not a new export.

IF PROCESSING IS RUNNING

Wait for completion or click Cancel before starting another job or switching sessions. Closing a browser tab does not stop the local server or necessarily cancel processing.

WHEN YOU ARE FINISHED

Close the launcher/Terminal window or press Ctrl+C (Control+C on Mac) to stop the server. An active job is cancelled on orderly shutdown. Completed sessions remain available after restart.

KEEP DOWNLOADS BEFORE DELETING

Download important tracks to your project folder first. Delete this session in the results area has the same destructive purpose as the sidebar x. Session data remains in the app folder until you delete it.

The recent-session list appears in the desktop sidebar. On narrow phone-sized layouts the sidebar is hidden; use a wider desktop browser for those controls.

SOUNDSHREDDER / 08
08 / QUICK REFERENCE

A few things worth knowing.

SUPPORTED INPUTS

MP4, MOV and other supported video containers; MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF and WMA. Use one file at a time. Limits: 500 MB, 10 minutes, mono or stereo.

WHAT STAYS LOCAL

Audio processing and session files stay on your computer. First-time setup needs the internet for dependencies and models. Update checks contact GitHub only when clicked.

THE CLEANUP TOOK TOO MUCH

Lower the layer reduction or bubble strength, shorten the selected range, or use fewer passes. Listen to Removed sounds for clues. AI separation can affect breaths, singing and overlapping effects.

A RUN SEEMS SLOW

Check the progress message; first use may be downloading weights. CPU can take much longer. Use NVIDIA GPU when available, and keep the launcher window open.

PREVIEWS DO NOT MATCH NEW SETTINGS

Apply changes with Update mix, or Clean up again when fresh inference is required. The app labels old previews until you update them.

SAVING AND REUSING AUDIO

Layer exports are 24-bit WAV; Bubble FX uses 32-bit float WAV. Preserve your original source and listen in the final edit. Use source material you have permission to work with.

Updating is manual: check for a new release, download the matching ZIP, close the app and extract into a new folder. Copy your old data folder into the new one while the app is closed to retain sessions. Run the new launcher and keep the old folder until everything is checked.
